On his last day of work, a software engineer attempts to salvage the digital remains of his wife before being discovered by his coworker.
"Downsized" by Ed Willey
Connect with the Filmmakers:
More About "Downsized":
After his employment is terminated, a software engineer attempts to recover the digital consciousness of his late wife. Whilst reengineering the process that originally “saved” her, he’s interrupted and must fight to save the woman he loves, at any cost.
